Close-up photos of ports, buttons, and analog sticks

response.reason: The witness identifies a Sony PS4 console with two boxed DualShock-4 controllers, so it can be priced at its worst case; seller claims about origin, slim model, hacked software, and new condition are unproven and would require additional proof to raise the value.
